summary: Constrain the reserved fixture privileged operator listener and legacy binding alias to the fixture-derived paths.

replay.detail: No claim replay or store mutation.

rules.detail: Reserved fixture privileged socket overrides, symlink leaves and parent aliases are refused before identity, store and bind effects.

compatibility.detail: Ordinary instance privileged listener configuration is unchanged.

downtime.detail: Source publication does not configure or restart a service.

manual.detail: Fixture privileged listeners must use the own instance root run/fractal.sock path.

recovery.detail: Refusal occurs before startup effects; no store recovery is needed.
